services.name: 2.5 Hour Amelia and Cumberland Island Guided Boat Tour
services.desc: 2.5 Hour Tour. Drive your own 2 man catamaran, while a guide (on his boat) leads you to Fort Clinch, Cumberland Island, Ga and throughout the backwater of Amelia Island seeking wildlife, sea life and a superior boating experience Adventure Awaits you! This 2.5 hour tour has it all; Beautiful scenery, wildlife, sea life on some very unique and fast boats. After a brief on how to operate your own boat, this adventure takes you on a river run through some of the most beautiful backwater and marshlands that Amelia has to offer.
